description.en: Defines the annual earnings threshold, computed as four times the social-security ceiling ($PSS), above which the reduced CSG (Contribution Sociale Généralisée) assessment base of 98.25% of gross pay no longer applies and CSG is instead levied on the full 100% of gross income. It is used in tinty_fr's ArithOp function (Formula parameter, "Amount of CSG - earnings") and BenCalc function (Comp_perTU parameter, "Amount of CSG - unemployment benefits"), as well as the equivalent CSG-calculation functions in policy tscxc_fr. Theme_doc taxes.md confirms this exactly: the CSG base is "98.25% on gross income until four times the annual PSS, 100% above or for pension".
